style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft cloud-blue #C9E8F8 and misty sage #D9E4D3 for info and scene shots, wave-curve section dividers

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft playful baby-winter visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud-blue #C9E8F8, clean white #FFFFFF, misty sage #D9E4D3, charcoal-blue text #3A4A52 and one coral-red accent #D96A5F; bright soft high-key studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; rounded friendly sans-serif; soft rounded pastel badge circles with thin-line icons; clean baby-apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements on wave-curve sections; stable ghost-mannequin hero angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable straight-on or slight 3/4 hero angle, ghost-mannequin form, consistent scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte white seamless sweep #FFFFFF and light-grey fabric-drape board #E8E6E1
